title: X6887-16.3.0.150SP09-OP006PF001AZ-16.3.0.150SP21-OP009PF001AZ_20261001232118
description:
If the battery level is below 30%, please charge your device to at least 30% before installing the OTA update.

Update Version:
16.3.0.150SP21(OP009PF001AZ)

Calls
· Optimized audio stability during calls in weak network conditions to make call audio clearer and more stable.
· Fixed the issue where switching from Mobile Data to Wi-Fi could briefly interrupt connectivity in some scenarios, making network transitions smoother.

Home Screen & Control Center
· Fixed the occasional issue where badges did not appear on the home screen app icons after messages were received.
· Fixed the occasional issue where the home screen layout displayed incorrectly after a system update.
· Fixed the occasional issue where some Control Center icons were displayed incompletely after switching to High Resolution mode.
· Fixed the occasional issue where the lock screen wallpaper appeared inconsistent after a system update.

Performance
· Fixed the occasional issue where swiping up to exit AI Gallery responded slowly, making exit gestures more responsive.
· Fixed the issue where the More menu could lag when opened from the photo sharing screen in AI Gallery.
· Fixed the occasional issue where the notification shade responded slowly when swiping down, making interactions smoother.
· Fixed the occasional issue where swiping through the screenshot preview after taking a regular screenshot could stutter.
· Optimized the disappearing animation for floating notifications to reduce stutter and make transitions smoother.

More Functional Optimizations
· Fixed the occasional black screen issue in Facebook, improving the app experience.
· Optimized system resource scheduling to fix occasional crashes in some third-party apps.

Reminding:
· Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
· Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
